title: Special Executive Programme In Leadership And Organizational Behaviour
description: The course aims to equip learners with the tools to lead and manage organizational change effectively, while enhancing their understanding of leadership principles and organizational behaviour.
longDescription: This course explores the dynamics of leadership, organizational behaviour, and change management strategies. It delves into leadership roles, organizational culture, and system thinking, providing a strong foundation for driving organizational success and sustainable change.
courseDetails: What is meant by classical or traditional theory? What are the different types of organizational theories? What are human relations or neo-classical theory? Working of administrative theory. What is scientific management theory? What is meant by weber’s ideal of bureaucracy? How does the decision-making theory work? What is the modern organizational theory? What are Organizational systems thinking? What is System Thinking? What is the History of Systems Thinking? How is System Thinking helpful in the Workplace? How can an organization Create a Systems-based Organization? When Should We Use Systems Thinking? What is the Leadership and Organizational Structure? What Is an Organizational Structure? Understanding of Key features of organizational structure. Understanding an Organizational Structure. What are the different types of organizational structures? How an organization can Form an organization structure. What are the Benefits of Organizational Structures? What is the Leadership role in developing a Strategy? How can leaders exercise their leadership power and influence? Learners will explore different types of organizational change, strategies for effective change management, and the critical role of leadership. Topics include organizational theories, behaviour models, system thinking, and the development of organizational structures. By the end of the course, participants will understand how to align leadership with organizational culture and structure to foster innovation and adaptability. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding Leadership and Organizational Behaviour: Fundamentals of Organizational Theories: Understanding Organization System Thinking and Structure:
